assessment.status: Affected dependency version; deserialization paths removed by the reviewed Android release shrinker.
evidence: R8 usage report removes CompactHashMap.readObject(ObjectInputStream), CompactHashSet, CompactLinkedHashMap, CompactLinkedHashSet and MapMakerInternalMap including its serialization proxies.
Application and bundled Android plugin sources do not use ObjectInputStream or readObject.
assessment.limitations: Recheck reachability when dependencies, serialization behavior, shrinker settings or build type change. The dependency version itself remains affected.

scope: Known package/version advisories only; excludes SDK and locally patched code assessment.
limitations: No returned matches is not proof of security. Database coverage, vendored modifications, native build options and vulnerability reachability require separate assessment.
